paragraphs: For a City employee that is sponsoring a non-City person working for DPH.

sections.heading: Verify your role
paragraphs: Do you have a Disaster Service Worker (DSW) number? This is required to onboard a non-City person.
No: Contact a supervising City employee and direct them to Getting started at DPH

sections.heading: Review calendar
paragraphs: Check the onboarding calendar for dates of when the account request form is due

sections.heading: Get POI number
paragraphs: Does the non-City person have a Person of Interest (POI) number?
Yes: Enter their POI number on the account request form in step 3
No: Download and fill out this POI request form Then email the completed form to dph.requestPOI@sfdph.org

sections.heading: Complete account request form
paragraphs: Once you get their POI number,
Download and fill out this account request form

Make sure these columns are also filled out: Column P (DSW/POI): The person's POI number Column U (DPH Email Account Needed): Yes, only if the person is approved to have a SFDPH email Column W (Epic Access Needed): Yes, only if the person is approved to have Epic access

sections.heading: Email form
paragraphs: Send the completed form to dph.onboarding@sfdph.org .
Once processed successfully, you will receive an email from SFDPH IT Services regarding their account statuses.
